name: Pharmanutra S.p.A.
summary: Pharmanutra S.p.A., a nutraceutical company, engages in the research and development and marketing of food supplements and medical devices in Europe, the Middle East, Far East, North America, South America, and internationally. The company produces and distributes raw materials and active ingredients for the food, pharmaceutical, and dietary supplement industries. It offers Sucrosomial, a delivery system that optimises nutrient transport and absorption for minimising gastrointestinal side effects; and Cetylated Fatty Acids, a formulation for muscle and joint recovery in physiotherapy and sports.
